selection: Next original parameter point after P14, all 100 original shots. Selected before comparing P15 outcomes.
admission: Check two distinct TGA members and both 36-bit Pic logs per original shot, (Series,DataSetNr,RunNr) identity, monotone round timestamps, original image layout and size, P1/P15 detector rectangles, control configuration, timing and output lists.
rule: Sum over the 36 native P1 3x3 half-open rectangles in P15 raw pixels; strict count > T, no shifts, no background subtraction.
acceptance: Compare each of the 22 frozen rules with all P15 Pic1/Pic2 log decisions. Record every difference by round, frame and ROI. Report separate log and predicted first-frame rosters, pre- and post-selection denominators, target filling and full-array counts. The prespecified focus is the two P3 through P14 joint matches, 6499 and 6500. No P15 fitting. Report each frame’s observed range and whether it contains any log-positive sites. If the selected cohort is empty, report the 0/0 conditional rates as not estimable.
selection_rule: Pic1 count of all occupied sites >=16/36, independently for log and predicted mask. Pic2 target comprises zero-based ROI 7-10,13-16,19-22,25-28; report both point filling and fully occupied rounds.
scope: Same-series holdout on Knottnerus 88Sr; cross-apparatus comparison to Senoo 171Yb. Formal Senoo CAL/VAL uses its own measured inputs.
